description: NaCaZrFeSi₂O₈F is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.66 Å. There is one shorter (2.27 Å) and one longer (2.37 Å) Na-F bond length. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.88 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.22 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₅F octahedra, corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 54-59°. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.34 Å. Fe is bonded to five O and one F atom to form FeO₅F octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ZrO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 54-59°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.40 Å. The Fe-F bond length is 2.33 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₅F octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-66°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₅F octahedra, corners with three equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-55°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.65 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Ca and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Fe, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Zr, and two equivalent Fe atoms to form distorted ONaZrFe₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂CaFe tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaZrFeSi trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONaZrFe₂ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FNa₂CaFe tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaZrFeSi trigonal pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Zr, one Fe, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaZrFeSi trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONaZrFe₂ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent FNa₂CaFe tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaZrFe₂ tetrahedra. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Zr, one Fe, and one Si atom. F is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Fe atom to form distorted FNa₂CaFe tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaZrFe₂ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONaZrFeSi trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONaZrFe₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂CaFe tetrahedra.
